Bill Miller Menu: A Complete Guide to Delicious Meals and Sides

Bill Miller Bar-B-Q is a Texas staple, known for its delicious barbecue meals, hearty sides, and a menu that offers something for everyone. Whether you’re craving tender brisket, flavorful fried chicken, or the popular breakfast tacos, Bill Miller BBQ provides a range of dishes that satisfy any hunger. This guide explores the full Bill Miller menu, detailing the prices of each item, their offerings for delivery and takeout, and how to order your favorites online. With locations primarily in San Antonio and other parts of Texas, Bill Miller’s is an iconic stop for locals and travelers alike.

About Bill Miller Bar-B-Q

Founded in 1953 in San Antonio, TX, Bill Miller Bar-B-Q started as a small poultry and egg business and eventually expanded into one of the most recognized barbecue chains in Texas. With over 75 locations, Bill Miller offers a range of meals, from BBQ plates to breakfast tacos. The chain is especially known for its brisket, sausage, and chicken dishes, as well as its fresh bakery items.

Bill Miller Bar-B-Q Menu Overview

The Bill Miller menu includes a variety of BBQ meals, sides, bakery items, and breakfast offerings. Whether you’re stopping by for lunch, dinner, or a quick breakfast taco, the restaurant offers both dine-in and delivery or takeout options. You can also conveniently place your order online through their website or third-party delivery services like DoorDash and Uber Eats.

Main Menu Items at Bill Miller

Bar-B-Q Plates: The Stars of Bill Miller

The BBQ plates at Bill Miller are famous for their generous portions and rich flavors. Each plate includes a choice of meat, served with sides like potato salad, coleslaw, and bread. The meats are slow-cooked and smoked to perfection, providing that authentic Texas BBQ taste.

Popular BBQ Plates:

  • Brisket Plate: A hearty serving of smoked brisket, served with two sides and a roll.
  • Sausage Plate: Smoked sausage links served with sides like baked beans and coleslaw.
  • Chicken Plate: Juicy, grilled chicken served with potato salad and a drink.

Breakfast Tacos: A Texas Favorite

Breakfast at Bill Miller is incomplete without their famous breakfast tacos. These tacos are perfect for a quick morning meal and come with a variety of fillings, including eggs, sausage, bacon, and brisket.

Popular Breakfast Tacos:

  • Egg & Brisket Taco: Scrambled eggs paired with tender brisket in a soft tortilla.
  • Sausage & Egg Taco: A classic combo of savory sausage and fluffy eggs.
  • Potato & Egg Taco: A vegetarian option with seasoned potatoes and scrambled eggs.

Sides: The Perfect Accompaniment

No BBQ meal is complete without a selection of delicious sides. Bill Miller offers a variety of traditional BBQ sides, including potato salad, baked beans, and coleslaw. Each side is made fresh daily and adds the perfect complement to your BBQ plate.

Popular Side Dishes:

  • Potato Salad: Creamy and tangy, made with fresh potatoes and spices.
  • Baked Beans: Sweet and smoky, cooked slowly for rich flavor.
  • Coleslaw: Crisp cabbage mixed with a tangy dressing.

Chicken Dishes: Crispy and Flavorful

For those who prefer something other than BBQ, Bill Miller also offers a selection of fried chicken and grilled chicken plates. These meals come with sides and drinks, making them a popular choice for lunch or dinner.

Popular Chicken Dishes:

  • Fried Chicken Plate: Crispy fried chicken served with mashed potatoes and gravy.
  • Grilled Chicken Plate: Marinated and grilled chicken breast served with potato salad and coleslaw.

Bakery Items: Freshly Baked Goodies

Bill Miller’s bakery offers a selection of fresh-baked goods, from soft rolls to sweet pies. These bakery items are made fresh daily and provide the perfect way to end your meal.

Popular Bakery Items:

  • Sweet Rolls: Soft and fluffy rolls with a hint of sweetness.
  • Pecan Pie: A rich and gooey pecan pie with a flaky crust.
  • Apple Pie: Classic apple pie with a cinnamon-spiced filling.

Ordering and Delivery Options

One of the best things about Bill Miller BBQ is the convenience of ordering. You can choose to order online directly from their website or through delivery platforms like DoorDash or Uber Eats. They offer pickup and delivery options for most locations, ensuring that you can enjoy your BBQ favorites whether you’re at home or at work.

How to Order:

  • Visit the Bill Miller BBQ website or app.
  • Select your location and choose from the menu.
  • Add items to your cart and choose between delivery or takeout.
  • Pay online and track your order.

Delivery Fees: Most delivery orders come with a small fee, typically around $2.99 to $5.99 depending on your location and the platform you use.

Bill Miller Breakfast Menu

In addition to lunch and dinner items, Bill Miller also offers an extensive breakfast menu. This includes breakfast tacos, breakfast plates, and sides that are perfect for starting your day off right.

Locations: Where to Find Bill Miller BBQ

Bill Miller has over 75 locations throughout Texas, with the majority located in San Antonio, Austin, and Corpus Christi. Their central location in Texas allows them to serve authentic Texas BBQ to a large customer base.

Popular Locations:

  • San Antonio: Home to the original Bill Miller BBQ, San Antonio has multiple locations spread across the city.
  • Austin: Bill Miller BBQ brings its signature flavors to the capital city.
  • Corpus Christi: Enjoy Bill Miller’s BBQ with a coastal flair at the Corpus Christi location.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. Does Bill Miller offer delivery?

Yes, Bill Miller BBQ offers delivery through their website and third-party services like DoorDash and Uber Eats.

2. What are the most popular items at Bill Miller?

The most popular items include the Brisket Plate, Sausage Plate, and Breakfast Tacos.

3. Can I order online at Bill Miller?

Yes, you can easily order online through their website or third-party apps for both pickup and delivery.

4. Does Bill Miller offer breakfast?

Yes, Bill Miller offers a full breakfast menu, including breakfast tacos, plates, and sides.

5. What are the bakery items available at Bill Miller?

Popular bakery items include Sweet Rolls, Pecan Pie, and Apple Pie.

Restaurant Timings

Each Bill Miller BBQ location follows a standard set of operating hours. Here’s the general schedule for most locations:

  • Monday to Saturday: 6:00 AM – 9:00 PM
  • Sunday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Breakfast is served during the morning hours, and BBQ plates are available from lunchtime through dinner.

With this guide, you now have a complete understanding of the Bill Miller BBQ menu. Whether you’re looking for the best BBQ plates, craving some breakfast tacos, or in the mood for a sweet treat from the bakery, Bill Miller has you covered. Enjoy your meal at one of their many locations, or order online for convenient delivery or takeout!
